Subject: Ridgeline 2P is back — limited units, no discount needed
Preview: A small restock just landed. Here's what's coming in.
Body: The Northbay Ridgeline 2P (NB-TNT-02) has been restocked in limited quantity.

If you've been waiting on it, here's what you're getting:

- 2-person capacity
- 3-season rating — built for spring through fall; not intended for winter alpine use
- 2.1 kg packed weight
- Ripstop nylon construction

This restock is small. Once these units are spoken for, we don't have a timeline on the next shipment.

No discount. No pressure. Just a heads-up that the tent is available again if your trip is coming up.
